pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 60 °C·d above 10 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1350 °C·d$(). Best near 30 °C; stops above 42 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -1.5 °C (-1 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 5.8-7 (tolerates 5-8). Roots 1.5 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 190, P 35, K 170 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 143 bu/ac (9 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Ear of Maize and Seed Corn. Grows two blocks tall.
